Agent View isn't available here

Agent View is a live browser your agent controls, so you can watch it test your app.

Your agent can't use a browser either

The same browser is the one your agent drives. Without it, your agent cannot open web pages to test your app.

How to get it

Install them here

Run this on the machine swe-swe runs on:

sudo apt-get install -y chromium xvfb x11vnc novnc websockify

This line is for Debian and Ubuntu. Then restart swe-swe.

Use another machine

The browser can run on a different machine. The setup page walks you through it.

Open setup steps

Leave it off

Everything else keeps working: Agent Chat, Terminal, Preview and Files.
